'''Druan''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who joined the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He was part of the team that followed [[Tanno Vik]], believing him to be on a mission for the Republic. Their location was given to the Empire by the traitor [[Brel Orus]] and almost everyone was killed, with Vik taken captive and Druan left badly wounded. After telling the [[Havoc Squad]] Vik's location, Druan succumbed to his wounds.<ref name="Target Acquisition" />

==Behind the scenes==
If the Trooper player had Elara Dorne as a companion, she would heal him and he would survive.
